title: Can You Watch Madeira's New Year Fireworks From a Boat?
description: Yes. Funchal's midnight fireworks fill the whole bay, and the sea is the one seat that faces all of it. Our 31 December night on the boat runs 22:00 to 01:00.
heroAlt: Funchal's New Year fireworks over the hillside city, seen from a boat in the bay at midnight
keywords: can you watch madeira new year fireworks from a boat
how long are the madeira fireworks

images.prompt: Midnight on 31 December in the bay of Funchal, seen from the open stern of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy. Two or three guests in warm jackets stand from behind, in silhouette, at the stern. Ahead, the city of Funchal rises up the hills like an amphitheatre covered in small warm lights, with dozens of fireworks bursting at once from many points across the hillside and the seafront, their colours reflected on the dark water. A large cruise ship lit up off the city on one side. Real night photograph, light smoke drifting, true colours.
images.alt: Funchal's New Year fireworks over the hillside city, seen from a boat in the bay at midnight

images.prompt: Late evening of 31 December at Marina do Funchal, seen from the pontoon: a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy tied up with low deck lights, the busy seafront and the Christmas lights along the avenue behind, people small and far away, before 22:00.
images.alt: The boat waiting at the Marina do Funchal pontoon on New Year's Eve
